events.headline: Travelers will experience single-lane closures 24/7 on I-90 at Hansen Rd. in Moses Lake (milepost 174) through February 2027. Eastbound travelers heading north or south of Hansen Road must use Exit 169 at Hiawatha Road. Westbound travelers heading north may use exit 174. Travelers heading south must use exit 169 and follow the South Frontage Road detour.
On I-90 eastbound just east of Rainier Ave S (MP 3) there is an incident blocking the HOV lane.  The State Patrol has arrived on the scene.
I-90 FROM US195 TO BROADWAY: Bare and wet.
The westbound Winchester rest area on I90 at milepost 161.83 will be closed for maintenance until further notice.
From 9 p.m. to 5 a.m. nightly on Monday and Tuesday nights, Nov. 23-24, the westbound I-90 on-ramp from 142nd Place Southeast will close for construction. Signed detours will be available.
I-90 FROM RITZVILLE TO SR 904: No current information available.
I-90 FROM BROADWAY TO THE IDAHO STATE LINE: Bare and wet.

The westbound I-90 HOV lane will remain closed near Lakemont Boulevard Southeast for up to a year starting Monday, Nov. 23, to support bridge construction on eastbound I-90. Three lanes of westbound I-90 will remain open through the area.

The eastbound I-90 off-ramp to Factoria Boulevard will be closed nightly from 9 p.m. – 5 a.m., starting
the night of Sunday, Nov. 22 to the morning of Wednesday, Nov. 25. A signed detour will be in place.
I-90 FROM SR 904 TO US 195: Bare and wet.
